<DOCSTRING>
Modifies anchor elements to open in a new tab if they are external links.

@summary Modifies anchor elements to open in a new tab if they are external links.

@description This function iterates over all anchor elements within the document and modifies their `target` and `rel` attributes if the link is external. It skips same-page anchor links and sets the `target` to `_blank` and `rel` to `noopener` for external links. It also adds a `data-external-link` attribute to external links and a `data-internal-link` attribute to internal links.

@returns {void} Narrows the `a` elements to those that are modified, ensuring they open in a new tab for external links.
</DOCSTRING>
